name: Alkogolnye Istorii
source:
Three of his friends came to Novosibirsk to visit Khat: Semyon, Bogdan, and Dima.
When everyone gathered, they headed to the "Drunken Whore" bar to see a familiar Bartender.
Arriving at the bar, they immediately started drinking alcohol and telling their epic stories:
- Semyon's story — an ordinary day of a thug;
- Bogdan's story — cooking meth;
- Khat's story — an ordinary Siberian wedding.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1917579972]Steam[/url]]
translation:
他的三个朋友来到新西伯利亚看望卡塔：谢苗、博格丹和迪马。
众人集合完毕，前往“醉妓”酒吧，见到了熟悉的调酒师。
到达酒吧后，他们立即开始喝酒并讲述他们的史诗故事：
- 谢苗的故事——暴徒平凡的一天；
- 博格丹的故事——烹饪冰毒；
- 卡塔的故事 - 一场普通的西伯利亚婚礼。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1917579972]Steam[/url]]
